title: Approve or deny
text: Approve only after verifying the four-character code, machine, organization and approving identity. During authorized setup the agent does this in the intended signed-in browser or on an already connected machine. yoke machines approve CODE shows the deciding identity and machine; yoke machines deny CODE refuses the request. Approval grants the approving person's identity; service routing grants no approval authority. Success has a separate Return to your terminal callout. Denial and expiry authorize nothing; unavailable codes show waiting machines. Expiry does not renew a code.
